requirements.evidence: Queues and Serve pages, routes (routes/web.php:58-59), lang keys and navbar links exist, but major contract items are missing or broken: no mount authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:32-35, app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:28-33); the whole 'Members page tabs' section is absent (no Members.php change, no members_tab_* keys); required view data accessGrants is missing (Queues.php:142-166); the confirmation flow is not wired (queues.blade.php:55-60 calls toggleActive directly, confirmToggle is never invoked); rename passes null instead of the re-derived slug (Queues.php:91); no rate limit in callNext (Serve.php:78-93); aria-labels are missing on the serve call button and modal actions; several labels are hardcoded English (serve.blade.php:12,22,26-28,35).

conventions.evidence: No #[Validate] anywhere although conventions require it for Livewire input (Queues.php:29,34; Serve.php:24); no server-side authorize in mount; internal helpers are public (Queues.php:142,150; Serve.php:41,52) violating 'keep internal methods protected/private'; hardcoded UI strings instead of lang (serve.blade.php:12,22,26-28; queues.blade.php:35); unused Gate import (Queues.php:12); duplicate lang key queues_activate (lang/en/ui.php:111 and 115, same in pt_BR); no docs/CHANGELOG update.

security.evidence: No authorization in mount (Queues.php:32-35, Serve.php:28-33) and the entity.queues route has no can: middleware (routes/web.php:58), so employees can load the queues page. Serve.php:52-72 resolves selectedQueueId with findOrFail and never checks the 'call' ability, so any member can list waiting tickets of a queue they have no grant for (foreign/missing ids also 404 instead of showing ui.serve_empty). lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked] and mode is unvalidated, so CallMode::from($this->mode) throws ValueError on tampering (Serve.php:24-26, 82). callNext has no RateLimiter despite the explicit requirement (Serve.php:78-93). Write actions are only saved by authorization inside the domain actions.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files and no modification to tests/; none of the new Livewire behavior (happy path, unauthorized call, tamper on selectedQueueId/mode, rate limit) is covered, contrary to conventions.md 'No production code without a test'.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess directly (Queues.php:58,97,116,137), which is right, but the access list does one query per membership via hasAccessGrant instead of the required accessGrants collection (queues.blade.php:124 -> Queues.php:150-166), the confirmation modal is unreachable dead UI (queues.blade.php:88-105), and modal markup is repeated four times.

readability.evidence: Dead code and leftovers: unused Gate import (Queues.php:12), unused confirmToggle path, unused lang keys (serve_select_queue/serve_mode* in lang/en/ui.php:115-121) while the view hardcodes the same labels (serve.blade.php:12,22), duplicate queues_activate key, stray '<?php // ... ?>' header blocks in both views (queues.blade.php:1-3, serve.blade.php:1-3), and mixed Portuguese/English/language-key strings in one view.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: two components, two views, two lang files, the navbar dropdown (default-page.blade.php:48,55) and the two routes (routes/web.php:58-59). No unrelated refactors; the extra ticket_*/serve_* lang keys are only supportive UI text.

issues.explanation: The entire 'Members page tabs' requirement is missing: no activeTab/setActiveTab, no tabs bar with role="tablist", no gating of the invite form to the invites tab, and no members_tab_members/members_tab_invites keys.

Neither mount authorizes anything (create on Queue / view on entity) and the queues route carries no can: middleware, so employees can open the queues page and its queue list instead of getting 403 as the task requires.

The waiting list resolves selectedQueueId with findOrFail and never checks the 'call' ability, so any member can read the waiting tickets of a queue they have no grant for; a foreign or missing id 404s instead of showing ui.serve_empty.
callNext() has no per-user/per-entity rate limiting, an explicit requirement and a conventions.md rule for sensitive Livewire actions.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests are shipped for any of the new components, routes, lang or navigation behavior, including the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests.

The return types and the TicketStatus reference are written with literal double backslashes ('\\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection', '\\App\Enums\TicketStatus'), which is a PHP parse error; even with single backslashes, getWaitingTicketsProperty() returns collect() while declaring an Eloquent Collection.

The detail modal's deactivate/reactivate button calls toggleActive() directly, so confirmToggle() is never reached and the required confirmation modal is dead UI; the confirm button is always labelled deactivate even for an inactive queue.

The contract requires view data accessQueue and accessGrants; the component exposes accessQueue() as a public method and has no accessGrants at all, and the view runs one QueueAccess query per membership, so the 'managers call without a grant' rule is not implemented either.

name, renameName and mode have no #[Validate] rules or $this->validate() call, so empty names and duplicate derived slugs are not surfaced on the fields and a tampered mode raises ValueError instead of a validation error.
lastCalledTicketId must not be client-writable but is a plain public property (not #[Locked]), and mode is unvalidated, so the browser can forge both values.
rename() passes null as the slug, so renaming 'Old' to 'New' does not re-derive slug 'new' as the task requires (the slug argument is left to an unknown default).

The serve view hardcodes 'Select Queue', 'Mode', 'Any', 'Priority only', 'Normal only' and has no aria-label on the ui.serve_call_next button, contradicting 'all text from lang/*/ui.php' and the aria-label requirement; the existing serve_select_queue/serve_mode_* keys are unused.

confirmingToggle is a client-writable public flag while the confirm modal dereferences $entity->queues->find($viewingQueueId)->name, so setting it with no viewing queue (or after closeQueue) causes a null-property error.
closeQueue() resets rename and toggle state but not accessQueueId/managingAccess, so 'every nested state' is not reset as required.
'queues_activate' is declared twice in each locale file (the first definition is silently overwritten), and several added keys (serve_select_queue, serve_mode_any/priority/normal) are unused.
The list row renders the status tag with hardcoded 'Active'/'Inactive' while the queues_active/queues_inactive keys exist, and Gate is imported but never used.
The project requires docs (architecture/business-rules) and CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] to be updated in the same change; neither is touched.
Both views open with a stray '<?php // comment ?>' block, which is not how sibling Blade views are written.

review.summary: The change adds the queue-management and serve Livewire components, their Blade views, routes, lang keys and navbar links, but it is not ready: the members-page tabs section is entirely absent, neither component authorizes in mount, the serve waiting list leaks tickets for queues the user cannot call, callNext is unthrottled, the confirmation and access contracts are not implemented, and Serve.php contains literal double-backslash type references that will not parse. With no tests at all and several hardcoded/aria-label violations, this needs substantial rework before merging.
